summary: Iteration 9 (WorldMap + AlertBanner + WidgetPreview) fully verified. Backend: 10/10 new iteration-9 tests pass + 32/32 iteration-7 & iteration-8 regression pass (42/42 combined). GET /api/countries now returns lat/lng floats for every country; PATCH /api/countries/{code} persists 'enabled' correctly and countries remained after re-GET (idempotent seed). GET /api/alerts default minutes=5 shape verified (window_minutes, error_count, warning_count, latest, events[max 10]); minutes=60 accepted; minutes=0 -> 422; minutes=61 -> 422; every returned event has level in {error,warning}. Feed generator emitted error/warning events within ~40s (test observed 1 error + 8 warnings in a 5-minute window). GET /api/widget/status returns all required keys (user_id, server_online:bool, active_ai:'7/7', jobs_today.successful/failed:int, active_jobs:int, recent_errors:int, generated_at:iso). Both /api/alerts and /api/widget/status return 401 without bearer token. Frontend E2E (390x844): superadmin login → Dashboard shows WorldMap (testID='world-map') with 6 region pills 'Asia · 7', 'Oseania · 1', 'Amerika · 4', 'Eropa · 4', 'Timur Tengah · 2', 'Afrika · 3'. Toggling off ZA + US via country-row-ZA / country-row-US in Pilih Negara and returning to Dashboard shrank Amerika 4→3 and Afrika 3→2 pill counts (live map update confirmed). AlertBanner (testID='alert-banner') appeared within ~30s showing '1 ERROR · 8 WARNING · 5 MENIT TERAKHIR' with latest event text 'AI 2 · ERROR — Menyusun profil demografi …' and 'Tap untuk lihat 7 AI · Live Feed'; alert-dismiss button hides banner (verified via is_visible=false after click). Pengaturan → WidgetPreview (testID='widget-preview') renders EXPORT 7 AI card with '7/7 AI AKTIF', '3 JOB AKTIF', '107 JOB HARI INI', 'SERVER ONLINE' status, '4 error 5 mnt terakhir' recent-errors line, and native-build hint referencing /api/widget/status. widget-refresh button re-fetches without error and updates the same widget content. Cleanup: two toggled countries restored back to enabled. No React Native red screens; only benign shadow*/boxShadow deprecation warning from styled-components in the web preview.
action_items: (Optional / non-blocking) Web preview logs a React Native web deprecation warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' — this comes from RN web internals but you may want to migrate any custom shadow styles in WorldMap / AlertBanner / WidgetPreview to boxShadow for cleanliness.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::alerts uses ge=1, le=60 on FastAPI Query — clean 422 boundaries at 0 and 61.
server.py::alerts filters {level: {$in: ['error','warning']}} at Mongo level and re-partitions error_count/warning_count in memory — response events are guaranteed to only contain those two levels.
server.py::widget_status computes active_ai from ai_agents.enabled and recent_errors from ai_events level=error within 5 minutes — matches spec.
server.py country seed sync uses $set on {name, region, lat, lng} and $setOnInsert on {enabled:code==ID} so restart never overwrites the 'enabled' flag once set — verified idempotent via PATCH → GET.
_generate_feed_events emits error with 5% weight (weights=[62,22,11,5]) and prefixes the message with 'ERROR — ' — spec-compliant.
Frontend WorldMap, AlertBanner, WidgetPreview each expose the required testIDs (world-map, region-pill-<region>, alert-banner, alert-dismiss, widget-preview, widget-refresh).
react-native-svg 15.12.1 renders SVG dots inside Dashboard on web preview without any red screen or metro error.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (WorldMap dots+pills, live country toggle refresh, AlertBanner appear+dismiss, WidgetPreview render+refresh)
